title: Conference planning meeting (non-engineering domain)
description: Marketing/events domain instead of software: venue contract, speaker lineup, keynote abstract, email campaign, website handoff, swag order. Tests that extraction quality generalizes beyond engineering standups, and that numbers (budgets, counts, deadlines) survive into descriptions.

key_points: revised quote: $18,000 for main hall plus two breakout rooms, catering separate, within budget
route through legal review before signing
get AV recording for all three rooms in writing (last year breakout talks weren't recorded)

expected_tasks.name: Lock the speaker lineup
key_points: six confirmed, need nine; two maybes get final follow-ups with a Friday decision deadline
backup list of five names to fill remaining slots

expected_tasks.name: Chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract
key_points: needed for the website and the printed program

key_points: wave 1: agenda announcement; wave 2: early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before price change; wave 3: final-week push

expected_tasks.name: Hand off speaker bios and headshots for the website
key_points: Diego updates the landing page speaker pages before email wave one goes out

expected_tasks.due: proofs reviewed today, order placed this week

six-week lead time last year, already tight
order placed immediately after design proof sign-off
